method: Isolated shared JS event model; not live resolver parity. Seeds 1–N, 6 stages, 12 gold/stage; recruit 6, gear 4, refresh 2. Packs grant two random recruits; drafts one of three; target guarantee replaces the third purchase. Focused policy uses authored preference scores, random policy samples offers. Neither measures player enjoyment. Combat fixtures are five unique rank-1 characters with no gear, 20 fixed seeds per cell. No live-game balance claims.
